# LL-G Lessons Learned & Gotchas

> Machine-readable knowledge base of coding gotchas. Before scripting, load this file, then load the llms.txt for each technology you are about to use. Load only HIGH-severity entries unless a specific topic is relevant.

## Severity Legend

HIGH = silent wrong output or hard-to-debug errors -- always load these
MEDIUM = obvious failures (build errors, test failures) -- load when relevant
LOW = style/convention, caught by linter -- skip unless explicitly asked

## Technologies

### PowerShell
- [PowerShell index](kb/powershell/llms.txt): All PowerShell gotchas (23 entries)

### Outlook
- [Outlook index](kb/outlook/llms.txt): All Outlook gotchas (1 entry)

### React Router
- [React Router index](kb/react-router/llms.txt): React Router 7 SSR and routing gotchas (1 entry)

### Next.js
- [Next.js index](kb/nextjs/llms.txt): All Next.js gotchas (25 entries)

### Express
- [Express index](kb/express/llms.txt): All Express (Node.js) gotchas (3 entries)

### Node.js
- [Node.js index](kb/nodejs/llms.txt): All Node.js runtime gotchas (6 entries)

### pnpm
- [pnpm index](kb/pnpm/llms.txt): pnpm workspace + linker + override gotchas: legacy bundled types fail tsc under the symlinked store + nodenext; npm install in a pnpm repo leaves stale physical packages that shadow pnpm's versions until a full node_modules wipe; pnpm v11 silently ignores package.json `pnpm.overrides` (they moved to pnpm-workspace.yaml) and DOES re-resolve range overrides, unlike v10; the `--` that npm needs to pass flags through `run` is what breaks pass-through in pnpm, turning the flag into a positional argument (4 entries)

### LLM Integration
- [LLM Integration index](kb/llm-integration/llms.txt): LLM / reasoning-model streaming + tool-calling gotchas: reasoning models spiral silently in delta.reasoning, looking like an empty hang (1 entry)

### MCP (Model Context Protocol)
- [MCP index](kb/mcp/llms.txt): Model Context Protocol server/host integration gotchas: a process-global stdio server (state built from process.env) must be spawned one child per session in a multi-tenant host or it leaks tenant data; partial credential updates wipe OAuth-captured hidden keys; a tool can be defined+deployed yet never named in the tools/list the server advertises, so grepping the source is a false negative -- and the route it wraps usually still accepts X-API-Key (3 entries)

### Tailwind CSS
- [Tailwind CSS index](kb/tailwind/llms.txt): All Tailwind CSS gotchas (9 entries)

### Base UI
- [Base UI index](kb/base-ui/llms.txt): Base UI (@base-ui-components/react) gotchas: rc.0 imports from @base-ui-components/react, not the renamed @base-ui/react the docs already show — copied imports fail to resolve; verify parts/props from the installed types (1 entry)

### Accessibility
- [Accessibility index](kb/accessibility/llms.txt): Accessibility gotchas: `aria-modal` is a declaration the browser does not enforce and a JS Tab trap does not satisfy it (use `inert`, refcounted); `forced-colors` discards backgrounds so any state carried by a tint -- active nav, selection, focus, status pills -- goes invisible (2 entries)

### CSS
- [CSS index](kb/css/llms.txt): CSS rendering gotchas: @font-face never renders in iframes; runtime-injected sheets resolve equal specificity by load order; a canvas preview must mirror drawImage rather than object-fit:cover; a global `zoom` scale is media-gated so phone CSS is in real px; `:where()` has zero specificity so a rule written with it guarantees nothing (5 entries)

### Data Viz
- [Data Viz index](kb/data-viz/llms.txt): Chart/visualization normalization gotchas: one shared divisor across mixed-scale metrics silently clamps the larger-scale ones (1 entry)

### QuickBooks Online (Intuit)
- [QuickBooks index](kb/quickbooks/llms.txt): QuickBooks Online OAuth integration gotchas: production apps reject http://localhost redirect URIs (host the callback on a public HTTPS origin); authorize/token endpoints are identical for sandbox and production and realmId arrives as a callback query param, not in the token response (2 entries)

### TypeScript
- [TypeScript index](kb/typescript/llms.txt): All TypeScript gotchas (43 entries)

### Biome
- [Biome index](kb/biome/llms.txt): Biome linter/formatter gotchas: the useOptionalChain autofix is not behavior-preserving (`a && a.b` keeps a falsy receiver, `a?.b` yields undefined); a repo-wide reformat reflows enough lines to break an unrelated line-count CI gate (2 entries)

### Graph API (Microsoft)
- [Graph API index](kb/graph-api/llms.txt): All Microsoft Graph API gotchas (40 entries)

### Exchange Online
- [Exchange Online index](kb/exchange-online/llms.txt): Exchange Online (EXO PowerShell / app-only auth) gotchas: app-only cert connects but cmdlets 401 until role propagation, Get-Mailbox masks it as a GetResponseHeader error (1 entry)

### Entra External ID (CIAM)
- [Entra External ID index](kb/entra-external-id/llms.txt): Microsoft Entra External ID (external tenant / CIAM) gotchas: workforce-blade lookalike trap, no email account-linking, MSA via custom OIDC only, fixed custom-IdP icons, branding asset limits (5 entries)

### Godot / GDScript
- [Godot index](kb/godot/llms.txt): All Godot and GDScript gotchas (12 entries)

### Better Auth
- [Better Auth index](kb/better-auth/llms.txt): All Better Auth framework gotchas (26 entries)

### Hono
- [Hono index](kb/hono/llms.txt): Hono routing and middleware gotchas (1 entry)

### Bash
- [Bash index](kb/bash/llms.txt): All bash shell gotchas (6 entries)

### Git
- [Git index](kb/git/llms.txt): Git tooling gotchas: `git ls-files`-based check guards skip untracked files (false green); concurrent agents sharing one working tree silently revert your uncommitted edits, so isolate your commit in a worktree; `git clone --branch` rejects a bare commit SHA (exit 128) and dies silently under set -e, use init+fetch+checkout FETCH_HEAD; a hook tracked as mode 100644 is silently skipped so the guard never runs on any clone; a hand-assigned version read at task start goes stale mid-session, and a duplicate version can merge cleanly with no error; verifying a GitHub write against raw.githubusercontent reporting a phantom lost update (6 entries)

### Linux
- [Linux index](kb/linux/llms.txt): Linux server ops gotchas: systemd service management, daemon restart policies, package-update restart races (2 entries)

### cmd.exe (Windows)
- [cmd.exe index](kb/cmd/llms.txt): Windows cmd.exe gotchas, especially for zero-disk-space emergencies (1 entry)

### Windows
- [Windows index](kb/windows/llms.txt): Windows OS administration gotchas: disk-full remediation (Installer orphan cleanup with all-orphan guard, read-only attribute silently blocking deletes, DISM 0x800f080a pending-servicing, OneDrive placeholder size inflation; Dell SupportAssist SARemediation snapshot bloat + unbounded VSS; DeviceMetadataRetrievalClient dllhost CPU spin fixed by disabling DsmSvc) (10 entries)

### Chrome
- [Chrome index](kb/chrome/llms.txt): Google Chrome / Chromium gotchas: a staged-but-not-relaunched auto-update leaves the running instance unable to spawn service workers, so OWA hangs on skeleton placeholders while other sites load fine and it reads as a network/DNS/M365 fault (1 entry)

### Teams & SharePoint
- [Teams/SharePoint index](kb/teams-sharepoint/llms.txt): Teams channel operations, file migrations, and SharePoint permissions (3 entries)

### Cloudflare
- [Cloudflare index](kb/cloudflare/llms.txt): Cloudflare Workers, Hyperdrive, Pages, and Zero Trust / WARP (Cloudflare One) gotchas (9 entries)

### Docker
- [Docker index](kb/docker/llms.txt): Docker / docker-compose image and orchestration gotchas: postgres:18 rejects the classic /var/lib/postgresql/data mount; `docker compose exec -T` drains an ssh heredoc's stdin and silently skips later commands (2 entries)

### NinjaOne
- [NinjaOne index](kb/ninjaone/llms.txt): NinjaOne API v2 and MCP tool gotchas (7 entries)

### SupportForge
- [SupportForge index](kb/supportforge/llms.txt): SupportForge gotchas: remote-agent heartbeat/executor pitfalls, ticket-API defaults that silently return the wrong rows (solved tickets in open queues, oldest-first message truncation, id-vs-MSP-number collisions), plus platform patterns like the portal backend outpacing its UI and dual-keyed ticket aggregates that undercount when scoped by a single key (9 entries)

### Tauri
- [Tauri index](kb/tauri/llms.txt): Tauri 2.x desktop app gotchas (4 entries)

### NAudio
- [NAudio index](kb/naudio/llms.txt): NAudio/WASAPI gotchas: MMDevice COM objects are apartment-bound with no marshaling proxy, so a UI-thread read of a background-thread device throws InvalidCastException E_NOINTERFACE and kills the app (1 entry)

### WPF
- [WPF index](kb/wpf/llms.txt): WPF/XAML gotchas: TemplateBinding does no type conversion (templated controls render silently empty); Topmost=True overlays silently lose their Win32 z-band when another app window activates; SizeToContent windows positioned after Show() land at the default cascade spot on first show; DispatcherTimer is capped near 64 Hz by the default ~15.6 ms timer resolution unless timeBeginPeriod(1) is requested (4 entries)

### Svelte
- [Svelte index](kb/svelte/llms.txt): Svelte 5 component and runes gotchas (4 entries)

### React
- [React index](kb/react/llms.txt): React hooks and lifecycle gotchas (5 entries)

### Rust
- [Rust index](kb/rust/llms.txt): Rust async-runtime, HTTP-client, and Windows process-spawning gotchas: blocking std::fs on the Tokio executor; GUI-subsystem console-child window flashing (CREATE_NO_WINDOW); reqwest multipart masking connect/timeout errors as body errors; reqwest 0.13 TLS feature rename; cargo update silently holding a crate back when a newer version drops a required feature; rubato 4.0 API restructure and the process_all whole-clip contract; Double Metaphone code collisions requiring a string-similarity confirm guard; libsqlite3-sys 0.38 hidden MSRV (opaque E0658, toolchain 1.95+); eframe 0.34/0.35 App trait split + panel unification; egui companion-crate version lag; startup set_theme clobbering the persisted theme preference; CollapsingHeader controlled-open one-frame latch; ScrollArea::show_rows uniform-height assumption; join-on-drop JoinHandle deadlock via sender-holding field drop order; mean-RMS silence gate over a padded audio window being utterance-length dependent; cargo check skipping test targets so breaking renames look clean; egui's monitor_size being unusable for window placement (no monitor origin, no per-monitor DPI) so overlays land off-screen on multi-monitor/mixed-DPI desktops; winit keeping WS_CAPTION on "undecorated" windows, so SetWindowRgn makes Windows paint caption buttons over a borderless overlay; an egui deferred viewport being torn down only by a parent pass, so a self-repainting child strands an always-on-top window when the parent sleeps; edition-2021 disjoint closure capture taking the bare non-Send field out of a `unsafe impl Send` newtype when the closure destructures it (20 entries)

### SQLite
- [SQLite index](kb/sqlite/llms.txt): SQLite query and data integrity gotchas (1 entry)

### Postgres
- [Postgres index](kb/postgres/llms.txt): PostgreSQL schema/DDL and query gotchas: boot-applied schema.sql not retrofitting constraints onto existing tables; ORDER BY ... DESC defaulting to NULLS FIRST, silently inverting a boolean preference/tie-break over a nullable column; a column that is NULL corpus-wide making any filter on it silently match zero rows; an empty cached column being upstream-null with the real signal in a sibling field the ETL drops (5 entries)

### M365 Admin Center
- [M365 Admin Center index](kb/m365-admin/llms.txt): Integrated Apps / Office add-in centralized deployment gotchas (1 entry)

### Intune
- [Intune index](kb/intune/llms.txt): Microsoft Intune endpoint-policy + app-management gotchas: Azure VM Entra-ID RDP tenant-wide oauth2PermissionGrant; Autodesk ODIS Win32 packaging + cert app-only upload; Managed Google Play apps need interactive iframe approval (not app-only POST); mobileApp assignment needs publishingState=published; iosStoreApp can wedge in processing; win32LobApp create needs the unified `rules` collection (not the legacy `detectionRules`) (6 entries)

### Azure
- [Azure index](kb/azure/llms.txt): Azure ARM and Az PowerShell gotchas: VNet gateway deploys, GatewaySubnet, service principal RBAC vs Graph scopes (2 entries)

### Hyper-V
- [Hyper-V index](kb/hyper-v/llms.txt): Hyper-V virtualization gotchas: Dynamic Memory's Startup RAM (not Minimum) is the host's boot-time allocation, so a VM still fails to start (event 3122) if Startup is left high (1 entry)

### Architecture
- [Architecture index](kb/architecture/llms.txt): Cross-service and system-design gotchas: data ownership, redundant stores, source-of-truth drift, derived-cache currency, precondition gates that measure a different collection than the consumer processes (9 entries)

### Cisco Meraki
- [Meraki index](kb/meraki/llms.txt): Cisco Meraki Dashboard API and licensing gotchas (4 entries)

### UniFi (Ubiquiti)
- [UniFi index](kb/unifi/llms.txt): Ubiquiti UniFi Site Manager API coverage gotchas (1 entry)

### Northflank
- [Northflank index](kb/northflank/llms.txt): Northflank deployment + addon gotchas: external-image upgrades don't auto-run Rails migrations, the Postgres addon app role can't run DDL, deleting a "CI-only" secret from an unrestricted secret group silently disables the runtime feature that also reads it, and a service's own pinned runtime env silently shadows the inherited group (9 entries)

### Railway
- [Railway index](kb/railway/llms.txt): Railway platform gotchas: `railway ssh` host-key verification hangs in non-TTY shells (1 entry)

### Claude Code
- [Claude Code index](kb/claude-code/llms.txt): Claude Code configuration and environment gotchas: hooks, skill frontmatter, settings.json, sandboxed Bash failures imitating a missing system dependency, worktree-isolated subagents silently working against stale content, scripted bulk edits landing on the wrong occurrence, mid-line @imports in CLAUDE.md being silently just prose, regex self-filters in Bash hooks misparsing git argv (12 entries)

### Windows DNS
- [Windows DNS index](kb/windows-dns/llms.txt): Windows / Active Directory DNS gotchas: Legacy-scope AD-integrated zones serve stale records on other DCs until forced reload; aging enabled without scavenging lets client registrations pile up at the zone root until the bare domain resolves to 100+ addresses and DC location becomes a coin flip (NETLOGON 5719) (2 entries)

### Active Directory
- [Active Directory index](kb/active-directory/llms.txt): AD domain-controller and Group Policy gotchas: multi-homed DC + stale DNS corrupts a newly promoted DC's local KDC (sc_verify OK but klist 0x52e), unrepairable, rebuild required; OU names lie, so an OU-scoped GPO can both miss its targets and hit POS/kiosk machines, use an include-group filter and keep Authenticated Users at Read (MS16-072) (2 entries)

### Prisma
- [Prisma index](kb/prisma/llms.txt): Prisma ORM migration and drift-detection gotchas (1 entry)

### WiX / MSI
- [WiX index](kb/wix/llms.txt): WiX Toolset / Windows Installer gotchas: major-upgrade RemoveExistingProducts scheduling can wipe runtime-modified data files (config.json) despite NeverOverwrite (1 entry)

### Antigravity CLI
- [Antigravity CLI index](kb/antigravity-cli/llms.txt): Antigravity CLI (`agy`) gotchas: hangs headless without empty stdin, print mode has no machine-readable stdout, blog-documented flags don't exist, and a clean exit 0 does not mean the plan completed (2 entries)

### Lumen (NaaS)
- [Lumen index](kb/lumen/llms.txt): Lumen NaaS API gotchas: price-qualify (/Product/v1/price) 422s if partnerId is sent with masterSiteId, while quote still needs partnerId for DC circuits; customer-port qualify now also needs serviceId; EoD EVC bandwidth modify is UNI-to-UNI only (3 entries)

### .NET Framework
- [.NET Framework index](kb/dotnet-framework/llms.txt): Legacy .NET Framework (CLR 2.0/3.0/3.5, WCF, GAC) gotchas: a Server 2025 in-place upgrade can leave System.ServiceModel 3.0.0.0 staged in WinSxS but un-GAC'd, so legacy WCF services crash at launch with SCM 1053 and no app log; fix = DISM disable/enable NetFx3 from media + reboot (1 entry)

### Drizzle ORM (drizzle-kit)
- [drizzle-kit index](kb/drizzle-kit/llms.txt): drizzle-kit migration-generation gotchas: an explicit `schema` file array (not a glob) makes db:generate ignore barrel re-exports and silently emit no migration for a new table file (1 entry)

### React Native
- [React Native index](kb/react-native/llms.txt): React Native + Expo gotchas: TanStack Query interval polling never pauses in the background unless focusManager is wired to AppState; nesting a VirtualizedList in a ScrollView warns and defeats windowing (2 entries)

### GitHub Actions
- [GitHub Actions index](kb/github-actions/llms.txt): CI workflow gotchas: the Azure Trusted Signing action reads service-principal creds from its own inputs (not step env:, which it clobbers), and adding a tag trigger changes the OIDC subject claim so no federated identity credential matches (AADSTS700213) (2 entries)
### Zod
- [Zod index](kb/zod/llms.txt): Zod schema-validation gotchas: .passthrough() relaxes unknown KEYS only, so a declared z.enum still rejects a newly supported value and the route handler never runs behind a generic 400 (1 entry)

### Jonas
- [Jonas index](kb/jonas/llms.txt): Jonas Club Management / Activity Management (JAM) gotchas: JAM users are provisioned in Club Management and pulled across by a manual gear import, never created in JAM, and a full active-user seat cap greys out New/Delete with no error message (1 entry)
